title: Unbounded derived direct-image cohomology as sheafified local hypercohomology
statement:
Let $f:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Work with module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on the sites of open subsets with open coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], in a common universe containing the spaces, their opens and the module values [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, the unbounded cochain derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The direct image is $(f_*F)(V)=F(f^{-1}V)$ with the $\mathcal O_Y(V)$-action induced by $f^\sharp$; its unbounded right derived functor $Rf_*$ is computed by applying $f_*$ termwise to a K-injective representative [def-sfb-right-derived-functor, def-pur-kinjective-complex]. For an open $W$ of a ringed space $T$ and $M\in D(\mathcal O_T)$, write $H^q(W,M)=H^q(R\Gamma(W,M))$, where $R\Gamma(W,-)$ is the unbounded right derived functor of evaluation $F\mapsto F(W)$, followed by forgetting scalars, computed on a K-injective representative. Then for every integer $q$ there is a canonical isomorphism of abelian presheaves on $Y$:
$$\bigl(V\mapsto H^q(f^{-1}V,E)\bigr)\cong\bigl(V\mapsto H^q(V,Rf_*E)\bigr).$$
The sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of either presheaf is canonically the underlying abelian sheaf of $\mathcal H^q(Rf_*E)$. The comparisons are natural in $E$ and compatible with restriction to smaller opens. No boundedness, quasi-compactness, or scheme hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0D5X (cohomology-lemma-unbounded-describe-higher-direct-images), with the natural Leray comparison of Tag 0D5W (cohomology-lemma-Leray-unbounded) used in its proof

proof.text: Use the published functorial K-injective replacement on X and Y. For a K-injective I on X put B=f_*I, and let r:B→J be its K-injective replacement on Y. The canonical total right-derived units are invertible on K-injective inputs. Their naturality, together with direct-image acyclicity, implies that g_*r is a quasi-isomorphism for every ringed-space map g:Y→Z: in the naturality square for the unit of Rg_*, the components at B and J and Rg_*(Qr) are invertible, so Q(g_*r) is invertible.

source.place: Tags 0D5W and 0D5X, with 0BKJ; direct-image composition acyclicity (0D5T)

proof.text: For each open V of Y use the Sierpiński space S={False,True}, with open singleton {True}, and the continuous classifier g_V(y)=(y∈V). Give S the pushed-forward structure sheaf (g_V)_*O_Y, so g_V is a ringed-space map with identity structure morphism. Evaluation at {True} is the stalk at True: {True} is the least open neighborhood, hence a terminal object of the opposite neighborhood category and its colimit leg is an isomorphism. Forgetting modules to abelian sheaves and taking stalks are exact, so this evaluation preserves quasi-isomorphisms. Apply the previous step to g_V. Its evaluation is literally Γ(V,r) after forgetting scalars. Thus every evaluation of the single abelian-presheaf map of r is a quasi-isomorphism, hence the presheaf map is a quasi-isomorphism. This includes V empty, where all the relevant sections are zero.

source.place: Tags 0D5W and 0D5X, with 0BKJ; direct-image composition acyclicity (0D5T)

proof.text: Naturality of the recorded right-derived unit for all local abelian sections, applied to r, now makes its component at f_*I invertible: sections of r become invertible after localization and the unit at J is invertible. The pasted unit localLerayCompositeUnit is therefore invertible on I. The defining universal factorization for localLerayComparison has this pasted unit as the composite of the invertible unit for the ordinary composite and the Leray comparison. Cancellation proves invertibility of the latter on QI. Every derived object is isomorphic to QI for some K-injective I, so naturality proves invertibility everywhere. Whiskering with homology gives exactly the prescribed localHypercohomologyComparison, including every restriction map.

source.place: Tags 0D5W and 0D5X, with 0BKJ; direct-image composition acyclicity (0D5T)

proof.text: For sheafification use the explicit exact-sheafification/homology natural isomorphism already displayed in localSectionComplexSheafificationIso: sheafification commutes with homology, the sheafification counit recovers a sheaf, and forgetting module structure is exact. The resolution comparison at the identity is natural for maps of K-injective complexes, by naturality of the total right-derived unit and of quotientCompQhIso. Compose this square with the homology factorization, the exact-sheafification square, and the inverse homology factorization. It is precisely naturality of localHypercohomologySheafificationModel.

source.place: Tags 0D5W and 0D5X, with 0BKJ; direct-image composition acyclicity (0D5T)

proof.text: For arbitrary derived M,N choose exactly the complex representatives and functorial K-injective resolutions used in localHypercohomologySheafificationAt. Conjugate a morphism M→N by their displayed resolution isomorphisms. The K-injective Hom bijection lifts it to a homotopy class, and fullness of the homotopy quotient lifts that class to a chain map. Apply the preceding model naturality square and conjugate back. The resulting natural isomorphism has components definitionally equal to localHypercohomologySheafificationAt. Whisker it by sectionDerivedDirectImage f to obtain s. Let t be sheafification of e followed by s; this is the required final equality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0D5W/0D5X and 0BKJ. The G1 proof specializes direct-image acyclicity using the Sierpiński classifier of an open, whose singleton evaluation is a stalk, and proves naturality of the specified sheafification models directly. This is a shorter route below the unit level.
